publications.name: The Long War – Codex Genestealer Cults

modifiers.value: Your army must contain at least 2 units from Codex – Tyranids
Your army must contain at least 2 units from Codex – Imperial Guard

rules.name: Necrotic Regeneration
rules.description: This unit gains the Regeneration special rule. In addition, the first time this unit is slain, instead of removing it from play, it is not. Instead, the unit remains on the Battlefield and Heals D3 wounds.

rules.name: Toxin Sacs
rules.description: A unit with this upgrade gains the Poison (4+) special rule on all Melee type weapons it is equipped with.

rules.name: Adrenal Glands
rules.description: A unit with this upgrade gains the Sprint (1) special rule.

rules.name: Chameleon Skin
rules.description: A unit with this upgrade may only be targeted in the Shooting Phase if it is the closest enemy model to the attacking unit. This does not confer to any attached units.

rules.name: Gorgon
rules.description: The Patriarch and any attached unit gain the Poison (4+) special rule on any equipped Melee weapons. If an equipped weapon already has the Poison (x) special rule, it gains the Shred special rule.

rules.name: Behemoth
rules.description: The Patriarch and any attached unit gain the Rage special rule.

rules.name: Kraken
rules.description: The Patriarch and any attached unit gain the Crusader special rule.

rules.name: Leviathan
rules.description: The Patriarch and any attached unit gain the Stubborn special rule.

rules.name: Jormangandr
rules.description: The Patriarch and any attached unit are treated as rolling a 6 on all Deep Strike rolls.

rules.name: Kronos
rules.description: The Patriarch and any attached unit gain the Indomitable Spirit (4+) special rule.

rules.name: Hydra
rules.description: The Patriarch and any attached unit gain +1 to their Weapon Skill (WS) while the Patriarch is attached to a unit.

rules.name: Cult Demagogue
rules.description: This unit and any attached unit gain the Hatred special rule.

selectionEntries.name: Toxin Injector Claw
selectionEntries.comment: todo: No profile provided in reference

rules.name: Psychic Stimulus
rules.description: When this Psychic Power is cast, select a single friendly Genestealer Cult unit within 12”. That unit may use the Psykers Weapon Skill (WS) and Ballistic Skill (BS) characteristic instead of their own until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

selectionEntries.name: Purestrain Genestealer Brood
selectionEntries.comment: todo: 105pts in Unit List instead of 125pts

selectionEntries.name: Metamorph Hybrids
selectionEntries.comment: todo: 75pts in Unit List instead of 70pts

rules.name: Las Gun Array
rules.description: If this unit is transporting Embarked models, it may make an additional 6 Attacks in the Combat Phase at its normal initiative with its Guard Crew Weapons.

sharedRules.name: Return to the Shadows (Reaction)
sharedRules.description: A Cult unit in your army with this special rule may set to Return to the Shadows instead of Setting to Overwatch. A unit that Sets to Return to the Shadows, if there are no enemy units within 3” of them at the end of your opponent’s Charge Phase, may be removed from the board. The unit may immediately be placed back on the Battlefield anywhere outside of 7” from any enemy models.

sharedRules.name: Cult Ambush
sharedRules.description: Units with this special rule gain the Scout and Outflank special rules.

sharedRules.name: Cult Specialists
sharedRules.description: For each Neophyte Hybrid unit in your army, a unit with this special rule does not take up a Force Organization slot.

rules.name: Flare Launcher
rules.description: A model with this wargear gains a 4+ Cover save. In addition, all friendly units within 6” of a model equipped with this wargear, including the equipped unit gain the Night Vision special rule.

rules.name: Psychic Familiar
rules.description: Once per game, a model with this wargear may automatically pass one Psychic test when attempting to cast a Psychic Power.

rules.name: Alchemicus Familiar
rules.description: Once per game, at the start of a turn, a model with this wargear may grant 1 friendly Genestealer Cult unit within 12” the Frenzy and Zealot special rules until the end of the turn.

rules.name: Sacred Cult Banner
rules.description:
Friendly Cult units within 18” of a model equipped with this wargear may re-roll Leadership tests. In addition, friendly Genestealer Cult units within 18” count as
having scored 1 additional wound in combat for the purposes of determining the winner of a combat.

rules.name: Mining Suit
rules.description: Basic Combat armour which can be sealed for hazardous environments. It provides a 5+ Armour Save. An equipped model may re-roll Armour Save rolls against weapons with the Poison special rule.

modifiers.value: A Cult that is based on a Void Station replaces their Mining Suits for Void Armour on all units in their army. Void Armour confers a 4+ Armour save.

rules.name: Cult Icon
rules.description: A unit with a model equipped with this wargear may re-roll 1 dice when making Pinning and Panic tests.

rules.name: Hardened Chitin
rules.description: Reinforced Chitin absorbs impacts. It confers a 5+ Armour Save.

rules.name: Bike
rules.description: A unit that is equipped with a Bike becomes the Bike type. In addition, the model gains +1 to its Toughness (T) characteristic.

rules.name: Quad Bike
rules.description: A unit that is equipped with a Quad Bike becomes the Bike type. In addition, the model gains +1 to its Toughness (T) and Wounds (W) characteristic.

rules.name: Biomorph Adaptation
rules.description: A model with this Warlord trait gains +1 to its Attack (A) and Strength (S) characteristic

rules.name: Cosmic Terror
rules.description: Enemy units within 3” of a Warlord with this trait halve their Leadership (LD) characteristic.

rules.name: Gestalt Siphon
rules.description: A model with this warlord trait may roll 1 additional D6 when attempting to cast a Psychic power, picking the best 2 dice. The Warlord and their attached unit gain the Indomitable Spirit (4+) special rule.

rules.name: Inscrutable Cunning
rules.description: If your army includes a model with this Warlord trait, during deployment you may place 3 trap markers. The markers must be placed outside of your opponents Deployment Zone. The area within 6” of each marker is treated as Dangerous Terrain.

rules.name: Meticulous Planner
rules.description: Once per game, if your army includes a Warlord with this trait, you can summon 1 Neophyte Hybrid unit. The unit arrives via the Outflank special rule automatically.

rules.name: Monstrous Form
rules.description: A model with this warlord trait gains +1 to its Strength (S), Toughness (T), and Wounds (W) characteristics. In addition, the Warlord gains the Battle-Hardened special rule.

rules.name: Prowling Agitant
rules.description: A model with this Warlord trait, when declared as the target of a Charge move in the Charge phase, the warlord may immediately move a number of inches equal to its Initiative (I) characteristic.

rules.name: Psychic Conduit
rules.description: A model with this Warlord trait increases the value of (x) by 1 for its Psyker (x) special rule. In addition, it gains the Force special rule on its equipped Melee weapons.

rules.name: Demo Caches
rules.description: A model with this wargear always Explodes as if it had rolled on an Explosion result on the Vehicle damage chart when it is wrecked, destroyed or slain. In addition, you may choose to trigger the demo cache on a unit at Initiative Step 0 of a Combat in the Combat Phase. All units within 6” of the model take 2D6 Strength 5, AP 5 hits.

rules.name: Devoted Crew
rules.description: A model with this upgrade may ignore the first Crew Injury Result suffered each Phase.

modifiers.value: {unit} must have a force stave equipped to take {this}

rules.name: The Amulet of the Voidwyrm
rules.description: A model equipped with this Relic gains a 4+ Invulnerable save. In addition the equipped model never suffers Peril of the Warp results and gains the Indomitable Spirit (2+) special rule.

modifiers.value: {unit} must have a power sword, bonesword, or locus blades equipped to take {this}

profiles.name: The Sword of the Void Eye

modifiers.value: {unit} must have a close combat weapon equipped to take {this}

rules.name: Icon of the Cult Ascendant
rules.description: This relic counts as a Sacred Cult Banner. In addition, all friendly Genestealer Cult units within 12” gain the Zealot special rule.

rules.name: The Crouchling
rules.description: This relic counts as a Close Combat Weapon. In addition, the model with this relic can attempt to cast 1 additional Psychic Power each Shooting Phase beyond its Psyker (x) limit. However, any doubles rolled on the Psychic Test result in a Peril of the Warp. Instead of resolving the Peril of the Warp as normal however, this relic can no longer be used for the rest of the game (as the Crouchling suffers the Psychic feedback instead).

rules.name: Telepathic Summons
rules.description: When this Power is cast, summon 1 Metamorph Hybrid or Acolyte Hybrid units wholly within 12” of the Psyker and more than 3” away from any enemy units. You can opt to summon 1 unit of Purestrain Genestealers instead, but the Psyker immediately suffers a Perils of the Warp regardless of their casting result.

rules.name: Mass Hypnosis
rules.description: When this Power is cast, select up to D3 enemy unit within 18” of the Psyker. The target units have -1 to their Weapon Skill (WS), Ballistic Skill (BS) and Initiative (I) until the start of your next Shooting Phase. In addition, any Reactions those target units were set to are cancelled.

rules.name: Mind Control
rules.description: When this Power is cast, select 1 enemy unit within 24” of the Psyker that is not an Automata or Drone Type. Immediately make a single Shooting Attack with the targeted unit as if it were your own. The unit is treated as your own for the purposes of determining friendly and enemy targets. The Shooting Attack by the controlled target unit are resolved as Snap Shots. The target unit is treated as an enemy unit immediately after its Shooting Attack is resolved.
